title: Concept: Submitted password echoed in a response
description: A password field returned in the response body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The response confirms the exact value the customer typed and carries it into logs, caches and error trackers, which is a plain credential leak.
applicability: Deployments that render a password field returned in the response body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The response confirms the exact value the customer typed and carries it into logs, caches and error trackers, which is a plain credential leak.
